framework.name: CIS Controls
framework.disclaimer: CSW evidence status, NOT a compliance attestation. Only the subset of safeguards CSW can technically evidence is mapped.

controls.intent: Establish and maintain a detailed enterprise asset inventory (agent-reported).
Segment data processing and storage based on sensitivity.
Implement and manage a host firewall on servers (workload-level enforcement).
controls.note: CSW workload enforcement is the host-firewall equivalent; coverage only, not rule correctness.

controls.intent: Establish and maintain a secure network architecture (segmentation defined).
Deploy network monitoring to detect anomalous activity.
controls.note: CSW provides flow telemetry, not signature-based network IDS.

controls.intent: Perform traffic filtering between network segments.

controls.note: Evidences network-flow logs, not host/application audit logs.

controls.intent: Collect detailed audit logs for network communications.
Establish an access-granting process for enterprise assets.
Establish and maintain a data recovery process.
Establish and maintain a security awareness program.
Establish and maintain an inventory of service providers.
Designate personnel to manage incident handling.
